roadGeometry.method: First ten simulated seconds of docs/benchmarks/2026-11-21-road-levels-city.json.gz, step 0.05 s. Rebuild changed shape keys at the actual two-second buckets including startup. Full geometry buffers for all changed edges serialized in traversal order; standalone test uses alluvialTerrainGeometry and createRoadGround for each road.

shippedGLBTest.input: adult male potter, clothing 100→25 after WebGL draw pass prepared (Babylon NullEngine)

districtLogistics.method: Ten district supply scans of the same saved city. The home access counter and CPU time trials were separate. Each of five timed repetitions (milliseconds) started from the same save; city contents were serialized after the tenth scan.

backgroundLoadObservations.metric: ps CPU percent, separate foreground Chrome renderer on the same Mac, sampled twice; 100% means approximately one logical CPU

assignmentTiming.source: 500 residents, 250 buildings, city snapshots at 0, 2.0, 4.05, 6.05, 8.05 simulated seconds; 3 dirty syncs per city per trial
